description: Effective Date of Termination (dismissal). Date is estimated by counting back 'two months three weeks' from the instruction date (2026-08-22); it is not fixed by any primary document (termination letter, HR record) supplied in this matter.
actor: Respondent (NHS employer body, unnamed - see F-025)
source: USER_ASSERTED - offset stated in task instruction, arithmetic performed this session
dispute_note: EDT stated only as a relative offset ('2 months 3 weeks before this instruction'), not as a calendar date, and not as an admitted or documented fact. 'Two months three weeks' is also not a precise unit (months vary 28-31 days), so even the offset arithmetic carries some slack. The real EDT must come from a termination letter or HR record before this date is relied on for any filed document.
legal_significance: Anchors the primary 3-month limitation period for unfair dismissal and whistleblowing detriment (ERA 1996 s.111/s.48) and, separately, the Equality Act 2010 s.123 discrimination time limit if the dismissal itself is the 'act complained of' for any discrimination head. See procedure/limitation.md for the full calculation and its caveats.

description: ACAS Early Conciliation certificate obtained (Day B under ERA 1996 s.207B), stated to be approximately one week after dismissal.
source: USER_ASSERTED - offset stated in task instruction, arithmetic performed this session against the CHR-001 assumption
dispute_note: Only the certificate date (Day B) is given. The date ACAS was first contacted to start Early Conciliation (Day A, ERA 1996 s.207B) is not stated at all (see F-004) - the s.207B stop-the-clock/extension calculation needs both, and cannot be completed from this event alone. The certificate itself would state both dates and has not been supplied.
legal_significance: Fixes Day B for the s.207B calculation. Without Day A, the true extended limitation date cannot be calculated to a real value - only illustrated (see procedure/limitation.md).

description: Date this instruction was given and the matter opened. This is the only fixed calendar date anywhere in the facts supplied; CHR-001 and CHR-002 are both derived by counting backward from it using the stated offsets, and are not independently fixed dates in their own right.
actor: N/A - instruction/matter-opening date, not a party act
legal_significance: Base point for the offset arithmetic behind F-002/F-003/CHR-001/CHR-002. Also confirms that, on the assumed EDT, today falls inside the primary 3-month unfair dismissal/whistleblowing limitation period either way (2 months 3 weeks is less than 3 months) - a REASONABLE, not VERIFIED, conclusion per procedure/limitation.md, since it rests on an assumed EDT.
